user.title: Orbitarium
user.description: Choose which satellite groups to load from CelesTrak. Positions are calculated locally for your Home Assistant location. Starlink alone has close to ten thousand satellites.

data_description.tracked_satellites: 25544 = ISS, 48274 = Tiangong, 20580 = Hubble. Each id gets a 'next visible pass' sensor.
data_description.min_elevation: Passes lower than this above the horizon are ignored.

error.invalid_norad: Use numeric NORAD catalogue ids separated by commas.
